hook: Every hooligan in history owes their name to one very rowdy family.
modernAnchor: Football riots. Smashed windows. A teenager doing something no one can explain.

origin.originalMeaning: an Irish surname from a notorious South London family

journey: In 1890s South London, a family called the Hooligans became notorious for street fighting and disorder.
Newspapers wrote about them by name. Hooligan became shorthand for that specific kind of reckless trouble.
Police reports, court records, headlines - the name spread faster than any of the family's actual crimes.
One Irish family's surname became the word the whole world uses for a certain kind of chaos.
